summary: Cenntro Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $100,000,000 of common stock under a Sales Agreement dated October 9, 2026 with Pacific Century Securities, LLC as sales agent. Shares trade on Nasdaq under CENN; the closing price was $3.90 on October 8, 2026, with 17,585,452 shares outstanding and non-affiliate float valued near $81.2 million. The agent earns a 3.5% commission on gross proceeds, with no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation; watch dilution pace and any accelerated selling pressure on the stock.
